# The Signal Chain

> The Signal Chain is a guitar history and reference book published by Jason Colapietro. The site at guitar.solutions is the companion reference for the book — covering amp lineages, effect pedal history, signal path, and the story of the electric guitar's sound.

- Author / Publisher: Jason Colapietro (also known as Johnny Suede)
- Canonical URL: https://guitar.solutions
- Book: The Signal Chain — available on Amazon and major book retailers

## What The Signal Chain covers

The Signal Chain is a systematic guide to the history and science of electric guitar tone:

- Amplifier lineages: Fender, Marshall, Vox, Mesa/Boogie, and boutique amp history
- Effect pedal history: overdrive, fuzz, delay, reverb, modulation
- Signal path fundamentals: guitar → cable → pedals → amp → speaker
- The physics of guitar tone: pickup types, wood, tube circuits, speaker response
- Recording techniques and studio signal chains
- Notable players and their rigs
